items.title: An integral morphism which is a homeomorphism onto its image has property C
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies property (C) for an integral morphism which is a homeomorphism of X onto a closed subset of Y (statement lines 6161-6166, with property (C) delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5708-5726). The proof reduces the construction to a single point of an etale U over X (proof lines 6168-6180), uses integrality and the homeomorphism hypothesis to shrink U so that the fibre of the point is a single point (proof lines 6177-6180), and then appeals to the companion property (B) for the same morphism to find an etale covering of the base whose base changes factor through U (proof lines 6182-6195). The non-formal content is the reduction to a point together with the use of property (B). The claim is H2: one reduction plus one application of the companion result.
